headline: Net income surges year-over-year as per-share profit slips
summary_short: Huntington Bancshares reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of $0.34, down 2.9% y/y from $0.35 but up 30.8% q/q from $0.26, while net income rose 35.6% y/y to $727 million.
summary_long: Basic EPS of $0.34 fell 2.9% y/y from $0.35 but rose 30.8% q/q from $0.26. Diluted EPS of $0.33 mirrors this pattern: down 2.9% y/y, up 32.0% q/q from $0.25. Net income of $727 million grew 35.6% y/y from $536 million and 39.0% q/q from $523 million. Revenue is reported at $2.837 billion; the shard's prior-period values ($472M, $377M) reflect a materially narrower basis and are not compared.
